title: August and the Mixtape
author: Oscar Ishikawa
blurb: Yara Quintana, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
